Tim

- Writes fantasy-novel articles for an online magazine about novels, characters, themes and recommendations. Found the opportunity via a fantasy literature forum by pitching ideas. Writes more because it combines reading with sharing stories.
- Joined the forum 14 June 2023 and enjoyed discussing favorite books. Met a California Harry Potter fan in July and Skyped 8 Aug about characters and collaboration. Attended a fan event in July and hoped to attend a September book conference.
- On 21 Aug, balancing school, reading fantasy to take breaks from stress, and learning piano. Enjoys progress, various songs and especially a movie theme that brings back memories. Watching Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone with family felt magical: snacks, blanket and everyone absorbed in the film.
- Family is important. Thanksgiving tradition: prepare a feast, share what they’re thankful for, then watch Home Alone, Elf and The Santa Clause. Elf makes them laugh and feel festive. Tim decorated his own Harry Potter-themed Christmas tree.
- On 26 Aug, assignments/exams felt overwhelming, but he was determined to persevere and balance study and fantasy reading. Never played on a sports team; prefers reading/fantasy and travel to experience different kinds of magic. Added NYC to travel list after John’s recommendation and promised to report if/when he goes.
- 31 Aug: had been rejected for a summer job but stayed positive. Gave a class presentation on 30 Aug; nervous, but did it and felt it was progress. Likes experimenting with spices. Planned first Universal Studios trip for September 2023, especially excited for Harry Potter attractions; promised John an update.

John
- Basketball shooting guard, signed with Minnesota Wolves before 2023 season; opener was the week after 21 May. Worked on shooting percentage and adapting to team style; teammates were nice and he was having fun. Sees teammates as supportive second family.
- Enjoys sneakers. Considered Nike and Under Armour endorsements in June. On 16 July said he signed a Nike basketball shoe/gear deal and was discussing possible Gatorade sponsorship; also likes Under Armour. Networks through basketball contacts and marketing skills.
- Scored 40 points (personal best at the time) in a tough win between 9–15 July. Game felt electric; teammates celebrated at a restaurant, laughing and reliving intense moments. On 9 Aug reported a tight win the previous week; he scored the final basket and felt an adrenaline rush.
- Looked forward to an August game in Seattle, a favorite city for energy, diversity, food, seafood and fan support. Loves ocean and crab; started surfing around 2018 and likes its connection to nature and freedom. Visited Chicago in August and liked its energy, friendly locals and cultural variety.
- Grew up watching NBA with his dad, who enrolled him in a local league at age 10. Played through school, earned a college scholarship and was drafted. Biggest basketball goal: championship. Wants to give back/inspire people; partnered with local organization supporting disadvantaged children through sports and school.

Strength training builds muscle/power, prevents injuries and improves explosiveness/athleticism; he said it improved shooting accuracy, agility, speed and confidence. Shared workout-plan notebook.
- Often gathers with family. On 21 Aug shared a photo of family around a kitchen table. On 26 Aug said he’d visited home the previous week, catching up with family and childhood friends.
- Has visited NYC, loved exploring and trying restaurants, and called it a must-visit; offered to help Tim plan.

- 21 May 2023: John sent photos of jerseys on bed, two men by basketball machine, locker-room bench/lockers, shoes in a circle, bookcase with books/toys. Tim sent basketball game and table of books.
- 15 Jun: Tim shared book collection, bookshelf and MinaLima picture. John sent game photo and said being on court felt awesome.
- 16 Jul: John shared scoreboard/phone, teammates on court, people eating, jerseys in store, handwritten letter, basketball card, mannequin in blue suit/chair, Seattle sunset skyline, crowd, crab legs, beach/surfing and surfer. Tim shared books, Harry Potter-covered book and living room with brown couch/white ottoman.
- 2 Aug: John and Anthony attended charity event and entered Harry Potter trivia; a “super-nerd” won. John shared a signed-book photo; inspiring book reminded him to keep dreaming. Tim said he especially loves Harry Potter and Game of Thrones.
- 9 Aug: John shared arena-game photo.
- 11 Aug: Tim recommended Patrick Rothfuss’s The Name of the Wind for world-building and character development; protagonist is magician/musician. Sent photo of three-book set; John added it to reading list. John shared lucky basketball shoes in a box. He said their marks recalled resilience, determination, love of basketball, achievements/progress, successes, failures and friendships. Tim sent open-book page photo. They discussed games’ crowd energy vs. reading’s comfortable escape/freedom; agreed people find different paths to happiness and bliss. John encouraged Tim’s writing; Tim encouraged John’s dreams.
- 17 Aug: John said teammates warmly welcomed him back from a trip on 15 Aug; felt lucky to belong. Tim recalled belonging at July fan event. John shared basketball signed by teammates, a comforting, motivating reminder of their bond, support and his journey. Agreed supportive people help perseverance.
- 21 Aug: John shared DVD cover with castle, saying he loved first Harry Potter movie and owned the whole collection; shared family-around-table photo. Tim shared family on couch before fireplace, a day of food, love and laughter, plus photos of Home Alone, Elf, The Santa Clause and his Harry Potter tree. John shared his previous year’s Christmas tree, gym and workout notebook.
- 26 Aug: Tim shared book stack and bookshelf with clock. John shared girls’ basketball group photo: his high-school teammates for four years; and NYC skyscraper/cityscape. Tim praised skyline and wanted to visit; John described NYC culture, food and restaurants and offered help. Tim said the support meant a lot.

John encouraged him and shared a photo of butternut soup with spoon and butternut on cutting board; he improvised it, no recipe, and used sage. Tim planned to look up recipes. Tim asked about Universal Studios; John had never been but it was on his bucket list and encouraged the trip. Tim promised to report back; John wished him a safe trip.
